contexts.text: Bethel on the sea, i.e. on the west () = (an obscure state as to Knowledges)... for, in the Word, the west = what is obscure.
The west () = those who are to come; and also those who are not in love.
Thou shalt break forth to the sea, i.e. to the west () = good as yet obscure, thus in its commencement.
That the west, in the opposite, = evil. Illustrated.
Under Corner, see this reference.
The west = the good of love in its setting. AC 9648.

The west, or sea = a state of good in obscurity; for the reason that the sun = the Lord as to the good of love... and therefore its settings good from Him in an obscure perception. And, as a man... has obscure perception when he is in exterior things... the west is called also the sea. Explained. AC 9755. AC 10189.
The west, for the Heavens, is (at the back), opposite the Sun. HH 141. HH 142. DLW 129, General article.
In Heaven... they who are in obscure perception of good are in the west. HH 148.
So in each Society... those in a less degree (of love and charity) dwell in the west.
Hence, the west, in the Heavens, = love and its good in obscure perception.
They who come to the Spiritual Kingdom, are introduced by the western (of the two ways from each of the places of instruction).
The evil Spirits between the north and the west. Described.
The Spirits in the western quarter towards the south. Described.
They advanced further into the western quarter.
Hence the Hells in the western quarter are the worst of all... Those in them described.
The direfulness of the (other) Hells increases according to their proximity to the western quarter...
The infernal kingdom opposite to the Celestial Kingdom is in the western quarter; and those there are called Genii.
The Swedes appeared towards the west; the Danes in the west.
Most of (the Papists) appeared in the western quarter... (Compare LJ 58.)
All the Mohammedans appeared in the west towards the south. LJCont 68.
In the west, dwelt, in front, those of (the Papists) who had lived in the dark ages. Described.
Lastly, the Judgment was executed upon those (of the Papists) who dwelt more remotely in the western quarter...
In the western quarter (of the spiritual London) dwell those who profess faith. At the right in this quarter is the entrance to this city, and the exit from it (for those who live evilly).
The west () = the evil of the natural man.
Those (Angels and Spirits) who are in a lower degree of love, dwell in the west.
Therefore the Spirits who are in the love of dominating from the love of self... look with their eyes to the west of that World...
Hence, in the Hebrew, the sea is the west.
On the west three gates () = introduction into the New Church for those who are... less in the love or affection of good; (for) the west = the love and affection of good in a lower degree.
They who are less (in love to the Lord and thence in affection, dwell) in the west.
The third company, which was the first of the wise ones from the western quarter (deliver their sentiments concerning heavenly joy and eternal happiness).
The fourth company, which was the second from the western quarter (do the same).
The prince entered by a wider door, from the west.
The Heaven dwellers in the west, (or those in the Copper Age) visited.
Adulterers are cast into the fires of the west, (which are) evil loves. CL 79:end.
We proceeded through the south to the region bordering on the west. Described. We entered the western tract of this region. Described.
Those in the phantasy of possessing all wealth (were found) looking to the west and the north.
On the left, towards the west (of the World of Spirits) are the Societies formed of those who are against love to God and towards the neighbour.
In the west are those who are in evil.
When a state of sunset (or of west) comes to (the celestial Angels) their mountains appear to sink down... according to the state of sunset at the time...
Those in the east had been in the greatest delight of exercising command... Those in the west, had been in such [delight] obscurely.
The Mohammedans who become Christians (in Heaven)... ascend higher and higher even to the west...
(The Babylonians) in the west were those who were in the greatest love of self, having the exercise of command as the end; those in the east were in the delight of the love of exercising command...
In the western quarter towards the south dwell those who are cunning and malicious, and who want to lead others towards the north [-west], where are those who are dull. See SE 5482.
See Last Judgment. SE 5535.

a. They are explored by this: that when let into the general or common state of their life, they turn themselves to the west; or if to the east, they spring back to the west... For to be turned to the west is to be turned to the world. (Continued. See East.)
To the west (in the other life) are those who are in the love of self, and in interior thick darkness.
Most of the cunning and deceitful dwell in the western quarter, partly upon lofty mountains, and partly in a plain...
He went remotely into the west, nearest the north, to the most wicked... He then went further, in the same line, and there stayed. There were evil ones there, but not so wicked as those at the front.

On those who are most remotely in the west. Beyond the most wicked of the Babylonish nation in the west, there are Hells... in which the wickedness is lessened by degrees, until you come to the Mohammedans and gentiles; and this for the reason that there may be equilibrium.
The places of (those who have been cruel, and after long vastation are devoid of perception) are in the extremity of the west, above the lands there.
A he-goat came from the west () = faith separated from charity originating from evil of life.
Those who dwell in the west are those who are in the obscure good of love. AE 417:2. AE 422:3. LJPost 12.
When the sea means the west, it = what is natural; because, in the Spiritual World, those who dwell in the western quarter are in natural good.
Into the east and the west, the Lord inflows with Divine good more powerfully than with Divine truth... consequently, these are more in love and charity...
Therefore the west, in the Word, = the good of love in obscurity. AE 724:20, Illustrated.
O Naphtali... possess thou the west and the south () = the derivative affection of truth and enlightenment. ( = the subservient good of love, and the light of wisdom. AR 354:2.)

The tribes of Ephraim, Manasseh, and Benjamin... pitched on the west (), because in Heaven those dwell at the west, and at the north, who are in obscurity of good, and in obscurity of truth, thus who are in natural good and truth.
They who are in the obscure affection of the good of love dwell in the western quarter (of the cities there); and also walk there...
The Heavens (of the Celestial Kingdom) are in the eastern and western quarter.
In the west (of the spiritual London) re those who are in the obscure affection of good: those who are there are timid at opening their thoughts.
